title: Sensor tests
subtitle: Mode 06 monitors + experimental module sensors
noMode05: No Mode 05 results yet — run tests (many ECUs do not support it).
modulesHelp: CAN-only, per-car addressing. Trust a value only once its badge says it was confirmed on this car.
noModules: No experimental module sensors for this car / protocol.

monitorFail.title: On-board monitor test failed (MID {{mid}}, TID {{tid}})
monitorFail.detail: The car's own self-test MID {{mid}} TID {{tid}} reads outside its limits. Open Sensor tests to see the value and the limits: the monitored part may need checking even before a fault code is set.

wiggleDropout.title_one: {{pid}} dropped out {{count}} time while the wiring was flexed
wiggleDropout.title_other: {{pid}} dropped out {{count}} times while the wiring was flexed
wiggleDropout.detail_one: The car gave no answer for {{pid}} once while its wiring and connector were flexed. Check that connector, its pins and the wiring for a loose contact or a broken wire.
wiggleDropout.detail_other: The car gave no answer for {{pid}} {{count}} times while its wiring and connector were flexed. Check that connector, its pins and the wiring for a loose contact or a broken wire.

wiggleUnstable.title: {{pid}} jumped while the wiring was flexed
wiggleUnstable.detail: The reading jumped by {{step}} {{unit}} between two reads while the others stayed close. Check the sensor's connector and wiring for an intermittent contact.
